However, during investigation, he colluded with others to fabricate false facts, instructed witness to lie, and gave false statements to investigation authorities. This is obstruction of justice, specifically "害司法公正" or "妨害国家机关司法活动罪" maybe "伪证罪" (giving false testimony) and "妨害司法罪". Chinese criminal law: Articles 307 (伪证罪) for giving false testimony, and 307 also for false statements to judicial organs? Actually Article 307: "伪证罪" includes: (1) 在法庭、仲裁机构、检察院、公安机关等国家机关的审讯、调查中作伪证; (2) 组织他人作伪证. Also Article 308: "妨害司法罪" includes obstruction of justice, like providing false statements, destroying evidence, etc. The facts: He instructed witness to lie (指使证人作伪证) and also gave false statements himself. So crimes: "伪证罪" (providing false testimony) and "妨害司法罪" maybe "妨害国家机关司法活动罪". The key rule: Use standard crime names from law. Usually Chinese criminal law uses "伪证罪" and "妨害国家机关司法活动罪". The description: "明知其行为会妨害国家司法机关正常的诉讼活动和他人作证的权利，仍然积极与他人编造虚假事实，指使证人作伪证，并且自己用编造的事实向侦查机关做虚假陈述". This matches "妨害国家机关司法活动罪" (Article 307? Actually Article 307 is for false testimony; Article 308 is for obstruction of justice). The phrase "妨害国家司法机关正常的诉讼活动" is typical for "妨害国家机关司法活动罪". So we should list both: "伪证罪" and "妨害国家机关司法活动罪". The key rule: list each separated by semicolon, no extra spaces. So answer: [罪名]伪证罪;妨害国家机关司法活动罪<eoa>
